text.text_excerpt: Yeah buddy! I'm totally digging this place. The bar has a great selection of German beers as well as other international and domestic favorites. The staff is really nice and very attentive to their customers. The bartender was even open to taking suggestions of other beers they should have on hand. I thought the prices were pretty comparable for their selection. I drank a hefeweizen draft all night and was very pleased when I got my tab. The ambience is cool for it being a small space; filled with German paraphernalia and a decent jukebox (Germany and NOLA represented heavily). Pretzels on the bar were a nice touch, although I'm not sure that is an everyday thing. I only have two small pr...

I just adored this place and I adore it enough to give it 5 stars. They have a huge beer selection here and the bartender, Todd, was really good at helping me find a beer that I would like. The bar itself it small, but I dig that because it makes for a cozy atmosphere. Although it's small, it's good for groups because they have 3 "picnic style" tables inside and a bunch of them outside, so don't be afraid to bring some friends along. Although the beers are imports, and some of them are on the more expensive side, most of them are super well priced and $5 or less in many cases. Nice, casual bar with really friendly bartenders. They're very sweet and attentive, although not always the most knowledgeable about the beers... they do have a really great collection though, so if you love German beers and have an adventurous spirit, you can have a great time trying all that they have to offer. Much more mellow of a place than some of the other bars in the neighborhood. Really like the outdoor seating. They should make use of the fun tree lights and actually turn them on!
